analysis.hold: BLIND HOLD: the formal OpenFOAM results are downloaded and hash-verified but NOT analyzed until the WaterLily-C side (Candidate C identity, runtime, deterministic floor, verifier) is immutably registered as XFID part B; part B may not change any rule in this file
analysis.openfoam_contrast: for direction d in {D0, D1, D2} and response r in {drag, downforce}: S_d,r = (mean over the 32 matched phases of R(d,+) - mean of R(d,-)) / 2, in N (drag positive downstream, downforce = -Cl force)
analysis.openfoam_resolution_rule: S is resolved iff |S| > 3 * SE_S strictly (equality is UNRESOLVED) AND |S| > 3 * (calibration sigma_e / 8) (drag 3.9e-5 N, downforce 2.2e-4 N); sign compared only for resolved contrasts
analysis.openfoam_standard_error: residuals of the phase values after a linear translation term (3 coefficients) fitted jointly over the six perturbed states with state-specific intercepts; s = sqrt(SSR/dof) pooled over those states (dof = 6n - 9); SE_S = s * sqrt(2/n) / 2 with n = number of matched phases (32); calibration prior sigma_e (drag 1.05e-4 N, downforce 5.94e-4 N) reported for comparison, not substituted

environment.note: lock chosen by the observed Ubuntu codename (X2: Jammy and Noble are bit-identical for the v16 fixture); host recorded in environment.json; any other OS fails closed with diagnostics

force_window.rule: last-25% iteration-tail window as in Round 5 and X2; forces in N from forceCoeffs Cd and -Cl

not_claimed: an adopted response floor (the formal registration adopts floors)
pending_part_b: WaterLily-C identity/runtime/source binding and the 7 state phi hashes
WaterLily-C deterministic floor and its resolution inclusivity rule
source-bound verifier hashes for both sides
per_case_failure_policy: record the failing stage and continue; checkMesh exit 1 with exactly one concave-cell failure and fraction <= 0.08 is allowed; no retries; result.json rewritten after every case
purpose: formal OpenFOAM side of XFID-01: 7 registered Stage V states (baseline, D0/D1/D2 at -/+5 mm) x 32 registered rigid shifts (Halton indices 17-32, 16 exact mirror pairs, disjoint from the calibration shifts 1-16), identical shifts for all states
reported_not_required: downforce ordering among the six perturbed states in each solver (requiring every pair to clear a floor would make AGREE unreachable by construction)
the one-sided differences from the unshifted baseline (an outlier phase, X2/X3 calibration)
required_comparisons: sign of S for D0 drag
sign of S for D1 drag
sign of S for D2 drag
sign of S for D0 downforce
sign of S for D1 downforce
sign of S for D2 downforce
scope_of_any_verdict: uncertified geometry (X1 practical gate only), reduced-laminar physical profile Re = 80, v17 flow_24 on the WaterLily side; no grid independence, high-Re or full-vehicle claim

shift_design.generator: Halton bases (2,3,5) for magnitudes and (7,11,13) for signs, rounded to 1e-6 mm; each vector paired with its exact mirror; all components non-zero; the same 32 shifts for every state (matched phases)

verdict_rule.AGREE: all six required contrasts are resolved in both solvers and the signs agree
verdict_rule.DISAGREE: at least one required contrast is resolved in both solvers and the signs differ; only this outcome stops Track C compute (an unresolved sibling never erases it)
